_about: NEX sentience-layer dependency DAG. Each node lists its prerequisites (edges pointing IN) and status. The build order is the topological sort of this graph. A node is 'buildable now' iff every prereq is 'built'. Run nex_next_dev.py to compute what's buildable / blocked / gap. This is the formal structure behind NEX_MIND_MAP_COMPLETE.md — the math the diagram visualizes.
_rule: buildable_now(node) := all(status[p] in ('built','live_unproven') for p in prereqs) and status[node]=='gap'. A live_unproven prereq is TREATED AS SATISFIED by the tool: dependents remain buildable and are tagged [LEANS ON UNPROVEN: ...] (nex_next_dev.py:79-81,102) — the tool FLAGS, it does not block. (Corrected 2026-10-11: the prior wording 'blocks ADVANCE until proven' described an intent the code never implemented; the project advanced to L4 over an unproven L3 deliberately — see L3_teeth_test note. To actually block, remove 'live_unproven' from _SATISFIED at nex_next_dev.py:29.)

L4_teeth.note: SELECTION/RETRIEVAL-coupling frontier (added 2026-10-11, Beam Part 3; placement provisional). Where L4_stakes moves a readiness SCALAR (decision-inert, see L4_stakes caveat), L4_teeth shifts WHICH content leads a fire. TWO loci, settled by grep 2026-10-11 (Beam C2): (1) FRAME version = demote the momentum candidate in global_workspace.arbitrate (NEX5_L4_TEETH, r81) -- BUILT, but the arbiter winner only prepends a framing line to focus_block (generator.py:3050); the body is fetched independently, so it is PROMPT-LEVEL, not mechanical teeth. (2) TRUE/RETRIEVAL version = modulate what is FETCHED: the focus_num-weighted branch/seed selection (generator.py:184-198 keystone seed, :1874-1877 NEX5_BRANCH_TEMP branch pick, _retrieve_context_beliefs:2624). The retrieval version is the real mechanical teeth the L3 note named ('retrieval weight shift on fixation, not a prompt hint') and is NOT YET BUILT. > L4 (moves content, not a clamp-absorbed scalar); < L4b/L5 (no persistence, no felt claim). Falsifier: flag ON must change what LEADS at matched cadence, on a primary blind to the winner (coverage/HHI, NOT p_on_subject which is definitional -- Beam C1). Prereq L3_teeth_test; parallel to the L4_stakes scalar. Persistent version = L4b_persistent_stake, which (Beam C3) must couple at the FETCH predicates, not arbitrate's score constants. UPDATE 2026-10-11 (measured, Beam D1/D3): BOTH built loci target the wrong layer. r82's carry divert is DECOUPLED from the pick (focus_num <- sense_events only, not the carry), and the branch almost never fixates (recursion_attrib switch rate s=0.878, runs >=3 in ~2% of fires) -- there is no branch-fixation groove to break. So L4_teeth-at-retrieval is a non-problem; the real lever is the PHRASING layer (crystallizer fidelity gate / generation prompt). Next: measure the phrasing-repeat base rate, then a phrasing-layer round (r83). Keep this node as the record; the live frontier moved to phrasing.

diversity_starvation.note: MEASURED 2026-10-11 (1000 fires vs 21d input) — the premise was INVERTED. The 'cold-3' (history/language/psychology) are SEED branches and are now OVER-fired, not starved: fire/input ratios 3.7/4.3/3.6 (fire 3.5/4.9/8.8% on input 0.9/1.1/2.4%). The starvation bonus (_STARVE_BONUS 0.15) over-lifts already-surfaced seeds. The REAL gap is structural: firing is restricted to the 10 hardcoded SEED_BRANCHES (bonsai.py:91), so high-input topics OUTSIDE the set never surface — news 13.5% input -> 0% fire; literature/neuroscience/mathematics/philosophy/science all have input -> 0% fire; cognition 14.5% input -> 4.5% fire (0.31x). So 'cold branch lift' is mis-targeted: it protects a fixed cold-3 while genuinely input-starved non-seed branches are excluded. OPEN DESIGN QUESTION (Beam): is the fixed-seed firing set correct (news deliberately kept out of contemplative fountain reflection) or a stale defect (the seed set should track the live input distribution)? Pre-screen + defect-vs-voice gate a fix before building. No lever built.
